title: Find the Largest Odd Number in an Array
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the largest odd number. If no odd number exists, return null.
think: What is the task asking? Find the largest value among odd numbers only.
What is the key operation? Check parity and track the current maximum odd value.
What wording signals stand out? Largest, odd number.
What is the brute force idea? Collect odd numbers first, then find max.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass keeping the best odd candidate.
What are the edge cases? No odd numbers, negative odd values, one element.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I scan the array and update the best odd candidate whenever I see a larger odd value.
algorithm: If num is odd and best is null or num > best -> update best
interview: I would scan the array once, keep only odd candidates, and update the current best whenever I find a larger odd value.
ru: Идём по массиву и смотрим только на нечётные числа. Среди них держим текущее максимальное.
visualExplanation:
nums = [8, 3, 10, 5, 11]
8 -> skip
3 -> best = 3
10 -> skip
5 -> best = 5
11 -> best = 11

important: Assume there is always an odd number

gaps: Nice to have: mention null when no odd value exists
constraints: Assume array may contain positive or negative integers.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan because we examine each element once and maintain a best candidate.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Sorting, because sorting is unnecessary for one answer.
Not Dictionary, because no frequency or mapping is needed.
